description:
Who We Are 
 At Kyndryl, we run and reimagine the mission-critical technology systems that drive advantage for the world’s leading businesses.  We are at the heart of progress; with proven expertise and a continuous flow of AI-powered insight, enabling smarter decisions, faster innovation, and a lasting competitive edge. For our people—Kyndryls—that means doing purposeful work that powers human progress. Join us and experience a flexible, supportive environment where your well-being is prioritized and your potential can thrive.
 
 The Role 
 We are seeking a highly experienced Senior Lead Platform Engineer to lead the design, implementation, modernization, and support of enterprise platform services across on-premises, cloud, and hybrid environments. The ideal candidate will possess strong expertise in infrastructure engineering, platform operations, automation, middleware, scheduling, database management, file transfer solutions, and production support within large-scale enterprise environments.
 The role requires leadership in driving platform stability, automation, observability, resiliency, security, and operational excellence while partnering with business, application, and infrastructure teams.
 
 Key Responsibilities 
 Platform Engineering & Operations 
 Lead the design, deployment, and management of enterprise platform infrastructure across UNIX, Linux, and Windows environments.
 Drive platform modernization initiatives including virtualization, automation, cloud integration, and infrastructure optimization.
 Ensure high availability, performance, scalability, and security of business-critical platforms.
 Manage platform capacity planning, performance tuning, system upgrades, and lifecycle management.
 Define platform standards, operational procedures, and support models.
 Infrastructure & Systems Management 
 Manage enterprise server environments, virtual machines (VMware/Hyper-V), storage systems, NAS platforms, and network integrations.
 Administer and support UNIX/Linux and Windows server environments.
 Lead disaster recovery, business continuity, backup, and recovery initiatives.
 Collaborate with infrastructure, network, and security teams on platform enhancements and issue resolution.
 Workload Automation & Scheduling 
 Administer and support Tivoli Work Scheduler (TWS) / workload automation platforms.
 Design and optimize batch processing, job scheduling, dependency management, and workflow orchestration.
 Troubleshoot critical batch failures and ensure SLA compliance.
 Database & Data Platform Support 
 Support Oracle databases and enterprise SQL environments.
 Perform performance analysis, query optimization, database monitoring, and troubleshooting.
 Coordinate with application and data engineering teams during releases and migrations.
 Middleware & File Transfer Services 
 Manage and support Managed File Transfer (MFT) solutions and secure file exchange platforms.
 Implement file transfer automation, monitoring, reconciliation, and incident management processes.
 Ensure compliance with security and data protection requirements.
 Automation & Scripting 
 Develop and maintain automation solutions using SQL/PLSQL,Python and Shell Scripting.
 Automate infrastructure provisioning, monitoring, operational tasks, deployments, and reporting.
 Drive Infrastructure as Code and operational efficiency initiatives.
 Security & Compliance 
 Work closely with cybersecurity teams to implement platform security controls.
 Support firewall configurations, network security policies, vulnerability remediation, and compliance requirements.
 Participate in audits, risk assessments, and security reviews.
 Monitoring & Incident Management 
 Lead major incident management activities for platform-related outages and critical issues.
 Implement proactive monitoring and observability practices.
 Perform root cause analysis and drive preventive measures for recurring incidents.
 Ensure platform SLAs, KPIs, and operational metrics are achieved.
 Reporting & Business Intelligence 
 Support enterprise reporting environments including Business Objects.
 Manage report scheduling, platform availability, performance optimization, and user support.
 Collaborate with analytics and business teams to support reporting requirements.
 
 Your future at Kyndryl 
Every position at Kyndryl offers a way forward to grow your career, from Junior System Administrator to Architect. We have opportunities for Cloud Hyperscalers that you won’t find anywhere else, including hands-on experience, learning opportunities, and the chance to certify in all four major platforms. One of the benefits of Kyndryl is that we work with clients in a variety of industries, from banking to retail. Whether you want to broaden your knowledge base or narrow your scope and specialize in a specific sector, you can find yourated with  
 
 Who You Are 
 You’re good at what you do and possess the required experience to prove it. However, equally as important – you have a growth mindset; keen to drive your own personal and professional development. You are customer-focused – someone who prioritizes customer success in their work. And finally, you’re open and borderless – naturally inclusive in how you work with others. 
 
 Required Technical and Professional Experience 
 Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, IT, or related field 

 8+ years of relevant experience in Platform Engineering, Infrastructure Engineering, or Enterprise Operations 

 Relevant Cloud, Infrastructure, Automation, or Platform Engineering certifications preferred 

 UNIX/Linux and Windows Server Administration 

 Tivoli Work Scheduler (TWS), Python, and Shell Scripting 

 Oracle Database and SQL 

 VMware/Hyper-V, NAS Storage, and Infrastructure Operations 

 Managed File Transfer (MFT) and Oracle Data Integrator 

 Firewall Management, Security Compliance, and Access Management 

 SAP Business Objects and Enterprise Reporting Tools 

 Azure Cloud, Kubernetes/OpenShift 

 DevOps and CI/CD practices 

 Monitoring & Observability Tools 

 Disaster Recovery and ITIL Service Management 

   
 Preferred Professional and Technical Expertise 
 Banking & Financial Services 

 Risk & Regulatory Reporting 

 Payments 

 Securities & Capital Markets 

 Lending 

 Treasury Operations 

 
 
 
 
 Being You 
 The “Kyn” in Kyndryl means kinship, which represents the strong bonds we have with each other, our customers and our communities. We focus on ensuring all Kyndryls feel included and we welcome people of all cultures, backgrounds, and experiences. Even if you don’t meet every requirement, we encourage you to apply. We believe in growth, and we’re excited to see what you can bring. At Kyndryl, employee feedback has told us that our number one driver of employee engagement is belonging. That sense of belonging — being a valued, respected, trusted member of the team — is fundamental to our culture and fueling great experiences for our customers. This dedication to welcoming everyone into our company means that Kyndryl gives you the ability to thrive and contribute to our culture of empathy and shared success. That’s The Kyndryl Way.
 
 What You Can Expect 
 Your career with us isn’t just a job—it’s an adventure with purpose.  We offer a dynamic, hybrid-friendly culture that supports your well-being and empowers you to grow. Our Be Well programs are thoughtfully designed to support your financial, mental, physical, and social health—because we know that when you feel your best, you do your best. 

From your very first day, you’ll dive into impactful work that powers the systems our customers rely on every day. You won’t just contribute—you’ll make a difference, tackling meaningful projects that sharpen your skills and fuel your growth.

We’re here to champion your journey. With powerful tools to chart your career path, personalized development goals aligned with your ambitions, and continuous feedback to keep you inspired and on track, you’ll have everything you need to thrive and evolve. You’ll develop in-demand skills to grow your career and achieve your ambitions with access to cutting-edge learning opportunities—from certifications with Microsoft, Google, and Amazon to coaching and hands-on experiences. And through it all, you’ll be part of a culture that values empathy, restless learning, and a devotion to shared success. 

We want you to thrive here—and we’re committed to helping you do just that. Ready to make an impact? Join us and help shape what’s next. 
 
 Get Referred! 
 If you know someone that works at Kyndryl, when asked ‘How Did You Hear About Us’ during the application process, select ‘Employee Referral’ and enter your contact's Kyndryl email address.
